definitions.explanation: A large, colorful butterfly of the family Papilionidae, known for its distinctive tail-like extensions on its hindwings.

examples.japanese: {庭|にわ}にアゲハが{飛|と}んでいる。
examples.english: A swallowtail butterfly is flying in the garden.

examples.japanese: アゲハの{幼虫|ようちゅう}は{柑橘類|かんきつるい}の{葉|は}を{食|た}べる。
{黄色|きいろ}と{黒|くろ}の{模様|もよう}が{美|うつく}しいアゲハを{見|み}つけた。
examples.english: I found a swallowtail butterfly with beautiful yellow and black patterns.

notes:
アゲハ refers to swallowtail butterflies, one of the most recognizable butterfly families in Japan. The full name is アゲハ{蝶|ちょう}, but アゲハ alone is commonly understood.

ORTHOGRAPHY:
Written as アゲハ (katakana, most common), {揚羽|あげは} (kanji), or あげは (hiragana).

COMMON SPECIES IN JAPAN:
- ナミアゲハ: Asian swallowtail (most common, found in gardens)
- キアゲハ: Old World swallowtail
- クロアゲハ: black swallowtail

CULTURAL NOTE:
The {揚羽|あげは}{蝶|ちょう} pattern ({揚羽紋|あげはもん}) is a traditional Japanese family crest ({家紋|かもん}) associated with the Taira clan. It remains one of the most popular {家紋|かもん} designs.

RELATED:
- {蝶|ちょう}: butterfly (general)
- {蛾|が}: moth
